author: freeCodeCamp.org
description:
Learn how to move past generic AI-generated interfaces and ship high-end, production-ready web applications using modern AI coding workflows. In this hands-on course, you will gather deep project context, clone and restyle proven UI architectures, and implement dynamic, Apple-style scroll animations using Hicksfield AI. Finally, you'll see the complete end-to-end front-end build deployed live to Cloudflare.

❤️ Support for this channel comes from our friends at Scrimba – the coding platform that's reinvented interactive learning: https://scrimba.com/freecodecamp

- 00:00 Intro
- 02:25 Build Context
